section_a_current_gaps: The current approach treats AI sentiment as sufficient, but arXiv 2606.19698 (70,450 support conversations) shows sentiment and satisfaction disagree in 44% of cases, with sentiment correlating only 0.36 vs satisfaction 0.47. The product only outputs sentiment/category/urgency (PRD §7.1) — it misses whether the customer was actually satisfied and whether a concrete fixable problem exists. Additionally, 64% of consumers doubt review authenticity, yet there is no verification mechanism (public POST /api/feedback/:slug is open with only rate-limiting). Businesses spend 5-10 hrs/week responding (PRD §2), but there is no team collaboration client UI (§7.2: 'Partial — server member endpoints exist; no client UI yet'), no email notifications (§7.2 deferred), no data export (§7.2 deferred), no public API/docs (§7.2 partial), no multi-language (§7.2 deferred), and no insight-to-action loop (§7.2: 'No link from insight → action'). The AI chat exists (POST /api/ai/:slug/chat/stream) but feeds context without structured satisfaction/fixable-problem annotations.

section_b_fixes.fix: Add satisfaction + fixable-problem annotations alongside sentiment in AI analysis (replacing single 'sentiment' score with structured satisfaction estimate + concrete-issue flag).
section_b_fixes.why: arXiv 2606.19698 shows sentiment hides 44% disagreement with satisfaction and misses 'tolerated friction' (satisfied but reporting fixable problem) — the largest group. Business owners need to know if a customer was actually satisfied, not just tone.
section_b_fixes.maps_to: server/src/features/ai/service.ts, shared/contracts (Zod schemas for satisfaction/issue fields), client/src/features/feedback/types.ts, server/src/features/analytics

section_b_fixes.fix: Build team collaboration client UI (invite members, role-based access) since server endpoints (POST/DELETE /api/organization/:slug/members) already exist.
section_b_fixes.why: Single-owner dashboard blocks real adoption; businesses need shared access for staff to act on insights. PRD §7.2 flags this as P1 partial.

section_b_fixes.fix: Wire email notifications for high-urgency feedback (use existing AI urgency score + new satisfaction drop).
section_b_fixes.why: Businesses spend 5-10 hrs/week monitoring; proactive alerts reduce that to minutes and close the insight→action gap.

section_b_fixes.fix: Implement CSV/PDF data export for feedback + analytics (existing analytics endpoints /api/analytics/:slug/* provide raw data).
section_b_fixes.why: No export (PRD §7.2 deferred) locks users into the platform and blocks reporting to stakeholders. Increases retention by making data portable.
section_b_fixes.maps_to: client/src/features/analytics (export button), server/src/features/analytics/routes.ts (new export endpoint using existing Zod contracts), shared/contracts

section_b_fixes.fix: Add public REST API docs + token auth for integrations, leveraging existing internal REST endpoints.
section_b_fixes.why: PRD §7.2 says 'Partial — internal REST API exists, no public tokens/docs'. This unlocks enterprise adoption and integrations (CRM, Slack) without rewriting endpoints.
section_b_fixes.maps_to: server/src/features/auth/routes.ts (API token endpoint), server/src/app.ts (new /api/v1 docs mount), shared/contracts

section_b_fixes.fix: Enhance AI service with structured annotations (satisfaction estimate, concrete problem flag, urgency) and inject into system prompt for chat stream.
section_b_fixes.why: arXiv 2606.19698 validates LLM-based structured annotation (GPT-5.4) outperforms sentiment on 70k conversations. Keeps Gemini use but enriches output with evidence-backed fields.

section_b_fixes.fix: Add review authenticity verification layer (optional verified-purchase tag via order confirmation or POS integration) and surface trust indicators on public pages.
section_b_fixes.why: 64% of consumers doubt review authenticity. Without verification, feedback data value degrades over time.

section_b_fixes.fix: Build insight-to-action recommendations linked to analytics endpoints (e.g., /api/analytics/:slug/recommendations Pro endpoint) with direct links to member assignment / reply tasks.
section_b_fixes.why: PRD §7.2: 'No link from insight → action'. Recommendations exist but are orphaned without task routing.

section_c_new_features.feature: Structured satisfaction + fixable-problem AI annotations (replacing pure sentiment).
section_c_new_features.why: Directly addresses arXiv 2606.19698 finding (44% disagreement, satisfaction correlation 0.47 vs 0.36). Highest impact on insight quality.
Server endpoints exist but UI missing; blocks multi-user adoption. PRD P1 partial.
Closes 5-10 hr/week manual monitoring gap (§2). Low effort if wired into cron + mail provider.
Deferred in §7.2; increases retention and stakeholder reporting. Built on existing endpoints.

section_c_new_features.feature: Public REST API + docs + token auth.
section_c_new_features.why: Partial in §7.2; unlocks integrations. Low engineering cost since routes exist.
Addresses 64% consumer doubt; protects data quality.

top_5_recommendation: 1) Enrich AI service (server/src/features/ai/service.ts) with structured satisfaction + fixable-problem annotations (arXiv 2606.19698 evidence) — this fixes the core value prop. 2) Build team collaboration client UI (client/src/features/organization) since server endpoints exist (PRD §7.2 P1 partial). 3) Wire email notifications via server/src/jobs/generateInsights.ts + new mail service to close the insight→action loop. 4) Implement CSV/PDF export using existing /api/analytics endpoints (PRD §7.2 deferred, P2). 5) Launch public REST API docs + token auth (PRD §7.2 partial) to unlock integrations. These five address both research-backed quality gaps (sentiment failure, authenticity) and business-value gaps (collaboration, notifications, export, API) with minimal new API surface — mostly consuming or exposing what exists in PRD Appendix A.
